title: VLM-Guided Contact Retargeting and Generative Partner Modeling for Humanoid-Human Interaction
abstract: arXiv:2610.28523v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Humanoid-human interaction requires robots to operate under severe partial observability: during close physical contact, the human partner is occluded, truncated, or outside the robot's field of view, causing pose estimation to fail and often necessitating external tracking or privileged human state. At the same time, heavy mutual occlusions introduce errors into the human-human motion-capture data used for learning. We present REACT, a framework for learning deployable humanoid-human interaction policies from human-human demonstrations. REACT treats semantic contact structure as the key supervisory signal connecting demonstration processing, interaction learning, and onboard control. First, a VLM-guided contact modeling and retargeting pipeline identifies semantically meaningful contacts and transfers them onto humanoid-human geometry while preserving interaction structure. translated_title: 基于视觉语言模型引导的接触重定向与生成式伙伴建模的人形机器人-人类交互
translated_abstract: 人形机器人与人类的交互要求机器人在严重的部分可观测条件下运行：在近距离身体接触过程中，人类伙伴会被遮挡、截断或处于机器人视野之外，导致姿态估计失败，往往需要外部跟踪设备或特权人类状态信息。与此同时，严重的相互遮挡也会给用于学习的人与人之间动作捕捉数据引入误差。我们提出了REACT，这是一个从人与人交互演示中学习可部署的人形机器人-人类交互策略的框架。REACT将语义接触结构作为连接演示处理、交互学习和机载控制的关键监督信号。首先，一个由视觉语言模型（VLM）引导的接触建模与重定向流水线识别具有语义意义的接触，并在保持交互结构的同时将其迁移到人形机器人-人类的几何结构上。利用这些标注，特权交互策略学习……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出REACT框架，以语义接触结构为核心监督信号，通过VLM引导的接触建模与重定向以及生成式伙伴建模，从人与人交互演示中学习可在严重部分可观测条件下部署的人形机器人-人类交互策略。
en_tdlr: REACT is a framework that treats semantic contact structure as the key supervisory signal, using VLM-guided contact modeling and retargeting with generative partner modeling to learn deployable humanoid-human interaction policies from human-human demonstrations under severe partial observability.
